# MediaFlow Studio 1.1.1 — Studio polish

## ✨ What's new

### 🪟 A more tactile, "studio" look
- **Light on the edges** — glass surfaces, the sidebar and the main button catch a thin highlight on their top edge.
- **Subtle film grain** over the background: no more flat, plastic-looking gradients or color banding.
- **Glowing illustrations** — the big icons (Converter cards, scissors, download) now float in a soft halo of their own color.

### 📥 A livelier drop zone
- Clean **dashed outline** at rest; drag a file over it and it **lights up in electric blue**, grows slightly and fans out its cards.
- The **Images / Audio / Video** cards get their own icon and react when you hover them.

### 🎛️ Little details
- **GPU badge** at the bottom of the sidebar — a green dot with *NVENC ready* (or Quick Sync / AMF), so you know exports are hardware-accelerated.
- **Real keyboard keys** — shortcut badges (Ctrl, O, V…) now look like physical keys.
- **Main button** stays quiet until there's something to do, then turns bright blue with a soft glow.
- **Snappier navigation** — the active tab pill glides in 150 ms; the Audio Extractor icon was redrawn to match the others.

Already on 1.1.0 or 1.0.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
